The image shows a mango leaf with white/gray powdery patches scattered across the surface. The coating appears as irregular, dusty white spots distributed over the dark green leaf, which is characteristic of fungal spore growth on the leaf surface. There is no tip dieback, no dark necrotic lesions, and no black sooty coating.

This matches Powdery Mildew: white-gray powdery fungal colonies on the leaf surface.
